# thermo

Celsius and Fahrenheit.

## Command line

    thermo 37          # Celsius to Fahrenheit
    thermo -f 98.6     # Fahrenheit to Celsius
    thermo-table 30 40 # a table, one row per degree

## Library

    const { cToF, fToC } = require('thermo');
